The target video is three separate music-video shots of a living wet watercolor painting, the pigment blooming and drifting as everything moves.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The camera descends slowly forward like a drone toward the tiny purple glow on the wall while waves roll in and break white along the rocks, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>. The dew drop trembles, swells and falls from the bud tip while the camera pushes in slowly and the focus shifts from the drop to the bud, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>. The camera tilts slowly up the stem from the stones to the bud and the sky while the first stars brighten and the bud sways in the breeze, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds.
